args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. All 8 were reported with the width-free ratio, so the plane-sections check was not run. Rigid-body invariance and closure passed on every run.
Flagged (3): r02, r03 and r06, reason width_free_ratio_used. Their largest width-free ratio is negative (-0.019, against 0.074 in the other runs) and sits at 50 µm, at the tip edge. Their largest flank difference is at 284 µm instead of 1074 µm, so the curvature-rate profile has a different shape.
Cleared (5): r01, r04, r05, r07 and r08. Every summary matches the batch median. r05's single roll back did not change its result.
What the flagged runs share: the same differences in the flank and width-free part of the profile. Their centre REGR peak (52.96 vs 53.15 %/h), peak position (421 µm) and growth-zone length (684 vs 695 µm) almost match the batch. The robust z of ±2.13 only appears because the batch MAD is 0.
Caveat: the summaries are exactly the same within each group of runs (r02/r03/r06 and r01/r04/r05/r07/r08). That is unusual for separate roots, so check whether these runs use the same input movies.
